name: hbm_su_pg_stream_b_1019

reset_landing.why: 3 serial stages = one 3:4 epoch (12q): bridge / inject slot counters of both roots release on the same epoch-aligned edge (as hbm_su_pg_stream_1019)

pin_regs.reason: Every boundary bit has its register in RTL: vmr_cmd/su_wq go straight into the request bank flops, su_rr / ij_* / pg_fault are serial_rr / ijq / synchroniser flops, the LG tap registers its local/far/near inputs and outputs, inj_rd/inj_addr are decoded into the inject bank flops. A wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar (windows 2q..7q) and the VM 10/7 calendar.

fill_reason.pin_bound: 3,580 external pins (W 1,183 slice S band, E 1,117 LG near, N 758 far requests + COLL inject, S 522) on ~3,500 um2 synthesized: <= 6/um needs >= 197 um on W/E, so a 40-60 % outline (~80 x 80) cannot carry them; 216 x 259.2 = the proven pg_stream outline (GPL converged with routability ON at 0ff805777). Pin-bound, waived.

structural_change: HBM-PGSTREAM-B 10-19 (coordinator 07:11, HBM-SAFE-PGSTREAM option b): ONE tile = ot_hbm_su_static_pg_stream_split (pg_stream_q on clk_ctl + pg_stream_s on pg_clk) with the banked 2,346-b seam INSIDE as landed crossings, two regional roots. Replaces the abutted q/s halves (2 x 432 x 216; 2 x 2,346 seam pins; pin-legal outlines 1-3 % util; GPL-0305 under routability ON, gates 20261019-063054) and supersedes hbm_su_pg_stream_1019 (FAIL 0ff805777: cross_clock -126.9 / -479.3 ps on the 1q related default with logic in the crossing). The seam arcs are now bank -> mux -> register with calendar windows request 4q/2q, return 2q/4q, inject 3q/7q, constrained by spec seam_windows (set_max/min_delay, latency included, sign-off inter-clock reserve on top). RTL edges = TW3-PGSTREAM split (ij +1 serial, pg_fault +2 serial, given to H-D4G).

seam_windows.name: bridge_request
seam_windows.why: request bank n mod 2 written at serial n (tick 4n), read at stream 4n+6/5/4, rewritten 4n+8 (multirate_bridge_split.sv; bench measured 4q / 2q)

seam_windows.why: return bank written at the stream capture edge, staged one serial edge early (X = 8 at RR 10/7 and 18/15): setup 2q, rewrite-after-read 4q (bench measured)

seam_windows.why: inject banks written at stream 12m / 12m+3 / 12m+9, read at serial 12m+4 / +8 / +12, rewritten one epoch later (bench measured 3q / 7q)
